description: This file contains utility functions for managing bundled plugins in a build system, including reading plugin manifests, collecting source entries, and generating build artifacts and dependencies.

methods.name: readBundledPluginPackageJson
methods.description: Reads and parses the package.json file of a plugin, returning null if nonexistent or invalid.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines whether a package is a manifestless bundled runtime support package based on its name and entries.

methods.name: collectPluginSourceEntries
methods.description: Collects source file entries specified in the plugin's package.json or defaults to './index.ts'.

methods.name: shouldStageBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Checks if a plugin's package.json indicates it should stage runtime dependencies.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Collects top-level public surface files from a plugin directory, filtering out non-relevant files.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Main function that collects build entry information for all plugins in the bundled plugin directory.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Lists build entries with their file paths for each plugin, formatted for use in build scripts.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Lists all artifact files generated for each plugin, including manifests, package.json, and source files.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Lists runtime dependencies for all plugins that should stage dependencies.
